shots.title: 车内侧窗：长下坡，护栏后退、光斑流动
shots.prompt: From the first frame, [0-5s] lateral camera drift along the side window; guardrail posts slide by at constant speed, street-light pools sweep across the glass. Sound: wind buffeting, tyre hiss, quiet motor whine. No text, no numbers, no logos, no faces; keep the palette and framing.

shots.title: 长下坡全景：连续下坡，远处谷底
shots.prompt: From the first frame, [0-3s] slow downward tilt following the mountain road; [3-5s] hold the wide valley view. Sound: distant wind over ridges, faint tyre roll far below. No text, no road signs, no logos, no faces; keep horizon angle and palette.

shots.title: 轮毂与底盘：车轮旋转、悬挂轻微起伏
shots.prompt: From the first frame, [0-5s] wheel spins steadily, suspension compresses slightly over road texture, dust motes drift in the side light; camera low and steady. Sound: tyre rumble, faint motor whine changing pitch. No text, no readable logos, no faces; keep framing.

shots.title: 刹车盘红热：暗金属转红、热浪扭曲
shots.prompt: From the first frame, [0-5s] the brake disc heats: dark metal turns dull red from the edge inward, heat shimmer rising; camera holds micro, very shallow depth of field. Sound: high-frequency friction, faint tick of cooling metal. No text, no logos, no faces; keep composition.

shots.title: 电池包外观与 BMS 屏：冷光、线束、指示灯
shots.prompt: From the first frame, [0-5s] slow push-in on the high-voltage battery components; a few status LEDs blink in sequence, thin cables curving out of frame, dust in the air. Sound: low electrical hum, one relay click. No readable text on any screen, no logos, no faces; keep palette.

shots.title: 刹车踏板：脚掌下压、踏板行程
shots.prompt: Cinematic live-action close-up of a single dark brake pedal in a modern EV footwell at night, cold grey grade, one soft teal ambient light, dark carpet texture. [0-2s] the foot presses the pedal down smoothly and holds; [2-5s] it eases back slightly and the pedal returns a centimetre, shallow depth of field. Camera: micro shot on the pedal, one slow lateral drift. overall_soundscape: pedal spring, soft mechanism click, quiet cabin tone, no voice, no music. No text, no readable labels, no logos, no faces, no watermark, no flicker.

shots.title: 刹车盘热浪：红热区域扩大、颗粒逸出
